# RemoteAbility CIC

> RemoteAbility CIC (Companies House 16817651) is a UK Community Interest Company based in Preston, Lancashire. It supports homeless, disabled and neurodivergent people, and people recovering from addiction, through a four-stage Pathway to Independence: Safe, Stable, Ready, Independent. It provides active, person-centred navigation and advocacy (not just signposting) into housing, recovery, benefits and employment services, and a free Six-Week Pathway to Independence programme covering digital skills, safe AI use and self-employment support. It also runs UNLEASHED, a mobile rage-room-style smash attraction for events, as a social enterprise.

RemoteAbility CIC does not provide emergency accommodation or clinical rehabilitation directly. It helps people access the right services, complete referrals and applications, and stay supported.

## UNLEASHED (mobile rage room attraction)
UNLEASHED is a travelling, staffed, three-lane rage-room-style attraction: players throw reusable hard rubber balls from behind a barrier at approved smashable targets in a contained area. It's available for festivals, rallies, fairs, shows, universities and corporate events. Income supports RemoteAbility's work and a planned mobile food project. Price: £20 per person. Age limit: 16+.
- About UNLEASHED: https://remoteability.org.uk/unleashed
- Book UNLEASHED: https://remoteability.org.uk/unleashed-book
